CustomField.description: How many times a callout to any model is retried after a retryable failure (see Retryable Status Codes, and timeouts) before the turn fails. 0 means never retry. Between 0 and 5; anything outside that range, or blank, is read as the default (2) or the nearest limit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Extra attempts after a failed call to a model, for every model. 0 means never retry. Maximum 5.
CustomField.label: Retry Attempts
